statement: SK Hynix held a 58% share of the HBM market in Q1 2026, and says it has finalized long-term supply agreements with about 10 customers.
why: More than half of the world's HBM coming from one supplier concentrates the accelerator supply chain on a single point of failure.

impact.mechanism: Supplier concentration means any disruption or allocation choice at one memory vendor propagates directly into accelerator output.

evidence.excerpt: SK Hynix carried a 58% share of the HBM market in the first quarter of 2026, according to Counterpoint Research.

confidence.basis: Secondary article citing Counterpoint Research; single outlet, no primary document.
